scope: Segment DL3 host-originated, separator-free, self-delimited (':' ... '~') BUYPASS day/date/time, merchant cut time and end-of-day password segment carried in the Table Load Response (Data Block No. 3, Conditional) and forming the Date and Time Load Response
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 17302-17361 (Section 12.44), 9347-9453 (Section 11.7.3 Date and Time Load), 9130-9180 (Section 11.7.1.2 Data Block No. 3), 19992-20040, 20085-20100, 20875-20887 (Section 13.2 Elements 21, 22, 23, 25, 65)

rules.title: Segment DL3 maximum length is 23 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed ':' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
rules.note: 23 = ':' + 1 + 6 + 4 + 4 + 6 + '~'. The Date and Time Load Response layout (11.7.3.2) lists the same fields without '~' (SEGDL3-SME-003).

rules.title: Day of the Week(25,1), Current Date(21,6), Current Time(22,4), Cut Time(23,4) are all required and Host-sourced
Password (Element 65, 6 characters) is the only Device-sourced field in this segment, identifying the end-of-day function's password — every other field in Segment DL3 is Host-sourced
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: Section 12.44 says Source: Device, but the Date and Time Load Response (11.7.3.2) says Source: Host and describes it as 'the device password used for requesting host totals'. A host-originated segment cannot carry a device-sourced value without explanation (SEGDL3-SME-002).

rules.title: Segment DL3 fields are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the next field immediately follows
rules.note: All DL3 fields are fixed width and Required, so an unpopulated field is itself a defect that shifts every later field.

rules.title: Day of the Week (Element 25) is one digit 0-6 (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday); Current Date (Element 21) is MMDDYY; Current Time (Element 22) and Cut Time (Element 23) are HHMM; Current Time includes time-zone and daylight-saving adjustment
rules.note: Elements 22 and 23 list hour 01-24 and minute 01-60, which conflicts with HHMM clock values such as 0000 or 2359 (SEGDL3-SME-004).

rules.title: Password (Element 65) is numeric, variable length up to six digits, right-aligned and space-filled when shorter than six, and is matched against the password in the merchant's BUYPASS profile
rules.note: Element 65 lists a default password; test data must never use the default or a production password.

rules.title: Segment DL3 is Conditional in the Table Load Response (Data Block No. 3) and its fields form the Date and Time Load Response; it is sent only on those two responses

A Date and Time Load is initiated by the device with Load Type 'D' (Date and Time Load Request: '?' + Terminal Identifier + 'D'); the merchant load flag does not have to be set, and the response includes adjustments for the initiating device's time zone and daylight saving time

For devices that use an automatic cut time, the device should start the settlement procedure 30 minutes before the Cut Time (Element 23) if the clerk has not completed settlement for that business day
rules.note: Device behaviour driven by DL3 data; observable only through the timing of the subsequent Totals Request. Related: DL1 Card Type 164 (Auto Close) closes the batch 30 minutes before the default cut time.
